Wakizashi

脇差

Origin
Japan
Period
c. 1400 to 1876
Blade
45 cm
Weight
0.5 to 0.9 kg
Edge
Single
Grip
One or two hands

The wakizashi is the shorter Japanese sword, with a blade between 30 and 60 cm. In the Edo period samurai wore it beside the katana as a matched pair called the daisho.

Indoors, where the long sword was left at the door, the wakizashi stayed at the belt. Townspeople were allowed to carry one while travelling, but only samurai wore the pair.
